statement: The primary sphere-null class has countable subcomplex enlargements; W_* is accessible and any strictness over minRev(BC2) has a countable witness.
depends_on: REVLOC G.6-G.7 rechecked; Sullivan Section 3; A.7; A34.2
notes: Rechecked background and explicit corollary; not new stopping-rule movement. Equality, third-element existence, and full-fibre size remain open.
